advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Regional Maintenance Reliability Engineer
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. This role will support several ATS site locations within the Midwest and East. The role will be a remote home office and require 50% travel. Principal Duties / Responsibilities: Promotes and adheres to the ATS safety culture. Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and ATS policies and procedures. Partners with internal/external customer for engineered solutions to improve reliability and throughput. Identifies opportunities for Capital Expenditures for equipment replacement with supervision (develops and communicates ROI). Champions operating systems, critical elements, and best practices to enable a precision reliability culture. Knowledgeable application of common precision tools and practices. Fully understands reliability centered maintenance and deliverables (equipment specific maintenance plan -ESMP). Actively collaborates with maintenance team on the use of predictive, preventative, and precision maintenance technologies and strategies designed to identify or control risks prior to failure and ensure optimum maintenance execution. Understands and performs failure mode & effects analysis. Advanced understanding of Work Execution Management (WEM) to train and mentor on gaps & improvements identified through reliability strategy session performance. Performs, trains, and coaches ATS Root Cause, Bad Actor, and Fault Tree Analysis. Collaborates with leadership on alignment of ATS/Customer KPIs. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs), & Competencies: Essential KSAs: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (ABET accredited) or equivalent experience (ex. heavy industrial maintenance, reliability, or operations experience). Minimum of five years of reliability experience. Demonstrates ability to perform full array of reliability tool sets. Experience in Performance of RCA. Experience & Performance with RCM & FMEA. Master Level Proficiency in Predictive Technology. Vibration I Certification. Infrared I Certification. Machine Health Monitoring Strong Proficiency. Coaching & Experience with Work Execution Management. Strong technical understanding of electrical or mechanical components, tools, and designs. Ability to complete a failure mode effects analysis, cause and effect diagrams, root cause failure analysis, life-cycle costing, and risk analysis. Ability to research and apply new equipment technology / trends. Robust problem solving, mathematical, analytical, and decision-making skills. Proficiency with computers, maintenance systems, and applications, including Microsoft Office. Strong verbal communication, facilitation, and presentation skills. Strong reporting and technical writing capability. Ability to build and maintain positive, professional relationships. Demonstrated Leadership skills and experience collaborating with cross functional teams. Desirable KSAs Desire to develop into a leadership role Experience with data trend analysis, vibration analysis, motor current analysis, oil analysis, lubrication and hydraulic testing, laser alignment, nondestructive testing, infrared thermography, ultrasound technology, acoustic reliability technology, Weibull analysis, and Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing methodologies Knowledge of various government regulations such as, Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP), National Electrical Testing Association (NETA), Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Ultrasound I Certification Maintenance Lubrication Analyst I Certification CMRP/ARP/CRP/CRL Certification Green Belt certification STS certification Competencies: Drive & Motivation Interpersonal Skills Task Man

jobgether-jobgether:lever:989e0bed-42c7-.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:989e0bed-42c7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Mexico. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment. Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates. Requirements: Cybersecurity and threat intelligence interest: Suitable for aspiring CTI analysts, cybersecurity students or graduates, SOC professionals seeking CTI exposure, career changers, intelligence or security professionals transitioning into cyber, self-taught practitioners, and professionals with relevant cybersecurity certifications. Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions. Threat intelligence fundamentals: Understanding of threat intelligence concepts, threat actors, indicators of compromise, TTPs, threat assessments, intelligence requirements, and risk prioritization. jobgether-jobgether:lever:be7ba22e-1d3f-.title: Structural & Architectural Design Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:be7ba22e-1d3f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Structural & Architectural Design Engineer based in Germany. As a Structural & Architectural Design Engineer, you’ll contribute to the design of a major AI data center infrastructure project with demanding structural and operational requirements. You’ll work across building envelope, internal layouts, structural load-bearing systems, life safety, lighting, and technological infrastructure pathways. Your designs will need to support high-density AI computing and liquid-cooled equipment while maintaining resilience, security, and operational efficiency. You’ll collaborate closely with MEP engineers and other technical specialists to ensure architectural and structural solutions are fully integrated. The role also involves reviewing design-build packages, identifying risks, supporting permitting, and ensuring compliance with applicable building and fire-safety regulations. You’ll work in an international, technically complex environment where practical engineering judgment and attention to detail are highly valued. This is an opportunity to apply your structural and architectural expertise to next-generation critical infrastructure with significant future scalability. Design building envelope systems , including exterior walls, façades, roofing, and thermal and moisture insulation suitable for critical data center environments. Develop internal partitioning and space-planning solutions, including white-space and gray-space separation, security zones, fire compartments, corridors, and access-control layouts. Perform structural load calculations for raised floors, POD and racking areas, and rooftop mechanical equipment such as coolers and pump skids. Calculate floor-loading capacity for IT racks, including high-density liquid-cooled racks and CDU placement zones. Design tunnels and technological infrastructure pathways for cable trays, piping, and other critical services. Develop lighting concepts for white space, gray space, offices, exterior areas, and security zones in line with data center operational requirements. Coordinate architectural and structural drawings with MEP teams, accounting for equipment loads, ceiling heights, structural clearances, cooling-pipe routes, and electrical distribution. Review architectural and structural components of design-build packages, identifying technical risks, inconsistencies, and potential value-engineering opportunities. Ensure designs comply with applicable local building codes, fire-safety regulations, and facility resilience requirements . Coordinate with local authorities and relevant stakeholders on structural and architectural permitting matters. Support long-term space planning and design strategies that allow the facility to scale as infrastructure and computing requirements evolve. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in structural and/or architectural design , ideally involving industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, critical infrastructure, or similarly complex facilities. Demonstrated experience designing load-intensive facilities , including raised floors, heavy stationary equipment, and structures requiring detailed load calculations. Direct data center experience is beneficial but not mandatory; relevant experience from industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, or comparable environments is fully applicable. Proficiency with AutoCAD and/or Revit . Experience with at least one structural calculation package, such as Tekla Structures, Autodesk Robot Structural Analysis, IDEA StatiCa, or Dlubal RFEM . Proven ability to coordinate multidisciplinary designs and manage interfaces between structural, architectural, and MEP disciplines. Strong understanding of structural design principles, building layouts, space planning, and technical coordination. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c30c0f76-59f4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive - B2B SaaS based in Canada. This is an exciting opportunity for a full-cycle sales professional to help build and scale a repeatable B2B SaaS sales motion. You’ll own the customer journey from outbound prospecting and discovery through product demonstrations, follow-up, negotiation, and closing. The role focuses on selling practical technology that solves real operational challenges for warehouse and distribution teams. You’ll work closely with leadership, product, and customers, gaining direct insight into the market and influencing the evolution of the sales process. Success will come from your ability to build pipeline, understand operational pain points, earn buyer trust, and consistently close new business. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively without an extensive existing playbook or highly structured sales organization. Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to continuously improve processes. Experience selling technical, operational, logistics, or other B2B SaaS solutions is a strong advantage. Comfortable working collaboratively with founders, product teams, customers, and other stakeholders in a high-ownership environment. southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:2f.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. ABOUT THE ROLE Applied AI Transformation Managers are technically oriented strategic advisors and operators who ensure value alignment to our customer's most strategic projects and drive program delivery across several strategic accounts. You’ll be responsible for identifying strategic opportunities for our customers to realize value from Cognition’s platform and ensuring strong value capture and reporting. You will support delivery of enterprise wide programs to implement agentic AI, specifically by designing and building the operating model and delivery model for agentic AI. You’ll act as a trusted advisor to senior and functional leaders, designing value realization targets and delivering transformation programs. This role embeds with a select set of Cognition’s strategic accounts for upfront strategy work through in-depth program management and delivery. You will be on the frontlines of supporting customers turning productivity gains and quantifiable financial impact. You will pioneer the playbook for how the world’s largest enterprises get value from AI Agents. In this role, you will: - Work with customer leadership to identify, quantify and report value targets for productivity gains and financial impact - Ensure seamless operations and delivery for the overall customer program, in close partnership with the Cognition account team - Ensure everyone at customer and Cog has visibility on playbook implementation, consumption metrics and value metrics - Maintain great relationships and customer trust via delivery - Oversee onboarding and rollout to thousands of engineers, ensuring successful deployment - Apply world class analytical and technical program management skills to support customer executives and teams, particularly with value realization and tracking - Build centers of excellence within accounts and empower them through tailored enablement programs Requirements for the role: - Computer science or EE undergrad - SWE intern or full time work experience - 3-5 years at a big 3 strategy consulting firm with a strong background in value targeting and realization and technology strategy as well as a proven track record building and expanding client relationships - Ideally 2+ years experience at a startup in a customer facing role preferred - Thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments—you move quickly and grow quickly - Demonstrated ability to learn exceptionally fast You might excel if you… - have successfully been a part of complex enterprise teams, especially sourcing and managing account growth - have worked as a software engineer, SE, technical account manager or other technical role - previously founded a startup or were early stage at a high growth startup - are a competitive, highly ambitious person who loves working in high-intensity environments EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. special-special:ashbyhq:dab271e6-21df-42.title: Head of Brand Design
special-special:ashbyhq:dab271e6-21df-42.description: About Special Special is a new kind of holding company. Our mission is to maximize the efficiency of American taxpayer dollars by transforming its critical industries with AI. We acquire and operate businesses that form the backbone of the American economy and deploy SpecialOS, our proprietary operating system, to make them run more efficiently. Special is backed by leading investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Human Capital and former members of the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) team. Our team is small, technical, and systems-oriented. Everyone is an individual contributor. We expect strong work ethic and clear communication. About The Role You'll be the lead designer across the entire holding company, from Special's own brand surfaces (special.co http://special.co, marketing materials, announcements), SpecialOS (our operating system that runs our companies), and Figure Health (our first vertical). You'll work directly with founders, engineers, and operators in the field to turn messy operational processes into beautiful experiences. Design is a top priority at Special. This role is for a designer who wants range: one week you're refining a clinician workflow, the next you're designing a brand system for a new vertical launch. Responsibilities - Design end-to-end experiences across Special's brand, SpecialOS and Figure Health brand surfaces - Deeply understand the operators who use our OS every day — including time in the field at our vertical companies - Rapidly explore and prototype using both traditional and AI-assisted design tools - Partner closely with engineering to ship polished, production-quality experiences - Build and maintain the design system that scales across the holding company and every vertical we enter - Shape Special's external brand and visual identity as the company grows Basic Qualifications - Have shipped meaningful brand design work and/or product features on web/mobile - Care deeply about craft, clarity, and user experience - Are comfortable working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where the org and the product are both being built in real time - Are interested in real-world industries — healthcare, services, the physical economy — not just consumer software - Embrace new design and engineering workflows, including AI-assisted tooling - Communicate clearly and collaborate well across disciplines, including with non-technical operators Preferred Skills and Experience - Front-end development skills; ability to turn your designs into production - Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, execution, and range across product and brand - Experience translating design requirements from non-technical users - Familiarity with modern design and prototyping tools, including AI-native ones - Brand and visual identity work alongside product design - Experience working closely with engineers and founders in early-stage environments - Video editing experience Location In-person in NYC. Compensation and Benefits $180,000–$300,000 USD Base salary is one part of our total rewards package at Special, which also includes meaningful equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k), short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and additional benefits. Special is an equal opportunity employer.
